snippet.title: Vanity Fair: The Pursuit | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
Vanity Fair is a narrative-driven game that delves into the themes of "making choices" and "survival in the world of fame." Set in an alternate reality between 2004 and 2024, you’ll be drawn into the whirlwind of stardom after signing a high-stakes pact to make your cinematic dreams come true. When faced with crucial decisions, will you choose self-preservation or personal sacrifice for the well-being of others? Step into the golden age of entertainment and experience life as a director in a dazzling world of glamour, excess, and intrigue.
